title: Tertiary economic activities
competency: Explain transport, communication and tourism as support services.

keywords.def: Support services that do not produce goods: transport, communication, trade, tourism, health, education.
The movement of people from their home to another place for leisure, business or other purposes.

en.text: Tertiary activities do not produce goods; they support production. They include transport (land, water, air), communication (mail, phone, radio, TV, internet), trade, tourism, health, education and administration. Tourism is called a "smokeless industry".

am.text: ሦስተኛ ደረጃ እንቅስቃሴዎች ምርት አያመርቱም፤ ድጋፍ አገልግሎቶች ናቸው፤ ትራንስፖርት፣ ኮሙኒኬሽን፣ ንግድ፣ ቱሪዝም፣ ጤና፣ ትምህርት።

screens.title: Three jobs
screens.ask: A taxi driver, a teacher and a nurse. What do they have in common?
screens.after: They give services. Service jobs are tertiary activities.

screens.title: Tertiary economic activities
paras: Tertiary activities help the primary and secondary sectors.
By themselves they do not produce goods. They are support services.
Examples: transport, communication, trade, tourism, health, education and administration.

screens.title: Three tertiary sectors
items: Moving goods or people: land, water and air transport.
Sharing information: mail, telephone, radio, TV, fax, e-mail, internet.
Travel for leisure, business and other purposes. A "smokeless industry".
